Name: Mouth
Description: Create JaW and Lips System for Games

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Create JaW and Lips System for Games.
  v003: lip joints are spaced evenly by length (BindJoints: one per lip vertex or a fixed count). Tweak ctrls push the joints around them with a soft falloff instead of moving one joint. Every lip ctrl scales per axis (sx/sy/sz) and the scale falls off over the lip like its translate. Roll attr on Mouth_Up/Dw_Main_Ctrl, Zip attr on L/R_Mouth_Main_Ctrl. Jaw, collision and center ctrls are the same as v002. Dynamic jaw pivot: the JawPivot guide sets where the jaw rotates, Mouth_JawPivot_Ctrl (show it with Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl.PivotCtrl) moves it in the scene. Parent jaw followers (teeth, tongue) to Mouth_JawFollow_Null, not Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- TweakCtrlsAmount: tweak ctrls per lip, corners not counted (default 7).
- MidCtrlsAmount: mid ctrls per lip (default 5).
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- BindJoints: PerVtx = one joint per vertex of the lip edge, or a fixed joint count per lip.
- SetUpperEdge / SetLowerEdge: lip edge loops, corner to corner.
- Teeth / Tongue SetParent: Mouth_JawFollow_Null (follows the jaw around the dynamic pivot).
- Template parent examples: Jaw_Jnt, Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl.
- Template attrs-position examples: Lips_Center_Ctrl, Vis_Ctrl, Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
